_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 3 — Commercial consolidation (RJ 217 / IAS 27 / IFRS 10). Ten new schemas (ConsolidationGroup, GroupEntity, IntercompanyRelation, ConsolidationPeriod, EliminationEntry, TranslationAdjustment, MinorityInterest, Goodwill, ConsolidatedBalance, ConsolidatedIncomeStatement) enabling Dutch MKB holding companies to consolidate multi-entity financial statements. All quantitative logic is declarative (x-openregister-aggregations) per ADR-031 — no ConsolidationCalculator.php / EliminationMatcher.php services. Lifecycle automation per x-openregister-lifecycle; cross-schema preconditions (status-transition gates, accountant-review presence, balance-sheet equation, minority split) delegated to OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\ConsolidationGuard. Reuses the existing Administration register (per-entiteit GL) and the Nextcloud user directory for executor/reviewer FKs — a person is an NC entity, never an invented schema (ADR-022).

ConsolidationGroup.title: Consolidation Group
ConsolidationGroup.description: Definition of a consolidation circle (moeder + dochters) per RJ 217 / IFRS 10 (REQ-CONS-001). Holds the reporting framework, reporting currency, uniform fiscal-year end and default consolidation method. Wettelijke basis: BW 2:406. One per groepsstructuur; a ConsolidationPeriod runs a measurement for a specific period against this group.

parentAdministrationId.description: FK to the moeder Administration (existing Administration register) — the holding whose GL anchors the group (REQ-CONS-001).

reportingCurrency.description: ISO 4217 reporting currency for the consolidated statements (RJ 122 / IAS 21).

reportingFramework.description: Consolidation grondslag: RJ 217 (Nederlandse commerciële norm) or IFRS 10 (REQ-CONS-001). Gates goodwill treatment (design D5).

fiscalYearEnd.description: Uniform boekjaar-einde across all groepsentiteiten; divergent fiscal years require harmonisation (REQ-CONS-001).

defaultConsolidationMethod.description: Default consolidation method applied to entities that do not override it (RJ 217 §4-7 / IFRS 10 §19, design D2).

notes.description: Free-text remarks, e.g. exemption rationale (art. 2:403/407/408 BW).

state.description: Lifecycle state of the group definition.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable. Group structure and entities being defined.

active.label: Active
active.description: Group is live; consolidation periods may be run against it.

inactive.label: Inactive
inactive.description: Group dissolved or superseded; retained for history.

activate.label: Activate group
activate.description: Activate once the parent and at least one entity are defined (REQ-CONS-001).

reopen.label: Reopen group
reopen.description: Return an inactive group to draft for restructuring.

GroupEntity.title: Group Entity
GroupEntity.description: A deelneming within a consolidation group (REQ-CONS-001). Maps an Administration to the group with its eigendomspercentage, stem-percentage, consolidation method, eerste-consolidatie-datum and functionele valuta. Drives the per-entity column in the pre-elimination werkpapier (design D10) and the minority-interest split (design D6).

administrationId.description: FK to the entity's Administration (existing Administration register) — the source GL for aggregation (REQ-CONS-001 / REQ-CONS-002).

entityType.description: Role of the entity within the group (RJ 217 §3-7).

ownershipPercentage.description: Eigendomspercentage held by the group (REQ-CONS-001 / REQ-CONS-006).

votingPercentage.description: Stem-percentage; may diverge from ownership via prioriteitsaandelen. Defaults to ownership when omitted.

consolidationMethod.description: Per-entity consolidation method (RJ 217 §4-7 / IFRS 10/11/28, design D2).

firstConsolidationDate.description: Date the entity entered the consolidation circle; aggregation skips pre-acquisition periods (REQ-CONS-009).

lastConsolidationDate.description: Date the entity left the circle on desinvestering; CTA recycles to P&L on exit (REQ-CONS-005).

functionalCurrency.description: ISO 4217 functionele valuta of the entity; divergence from reportingCurrency triggers currency translation (REQ-CONS-005).

state.description: Lifecycle state of the entity membership.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable. Entity being mapped into the group.

desinvested.label: Desinvested
desinvested.description: Sold/exited; cumulative CTA recycled to P&L (REQ-CONS-005).

activate.label: Activate entity
activate.description: Activate once method and ownership are consistent (REQ-CONS-001).

desinvest.label: Desinvest entity
desinvest.description: Mark the entity as sold; recycle cumulative CTA (REQ-CONS-005).

IntercompanyRelation.title: Intercompany Relation
IntercompanyRelation.description: Mapping of an internal trade relationship between two group entities for elimination matching (REQ-CONS-003 / REQ-CONS-004). The "wegwijzer" that tells the eliminatie-engine which debtor account in entity A corresponds to which creditor account in entity B, with the matching tolerance.

debtorEntityId.description: FK to the GroupEntity carrying the debtor/sales side (REQ-CONS-003).

creditorEntityId.description: FK to the GroupEntity carrying the creditor/purchase side (REQ-CONS-003).

transactionType.description: Type of intercompany transaction the relation eliminates (REQ-CONS-003 / REQ-CONS-004).

defaultEliminationAccount.description: GL account number on the debtor side to eliminate (e.g. 8200 Intercompany sales).

defaultCounterpartyAccount.description: GL account number on the creditor side to offset (e.g. 7200 Intercompany purchases).

matchingTolerance.description: Override matching tolerance for this relation. Defaults to €10 absolute / 0.5% relative (design D3).

ConsolidationPeriod.title: Consolidation Period
ConsolidationPeriod.description: A consolidation run for a specific period (REQ-CONS-002). Container for the elimination werkpapier; carries the workflow state (open → eliminationPhase → review → closed → archived), the executor, computed elimination totals and the exception queue of out-of-tolerance mismatches (design D3). Snapshot is immutable once closed (REQ-CONS-008).

periodEnd.description: End of the consolidated period; balansposten translate at this slotkoers (REQ-CONS-005).

executor.description: Nextcloud user id of the user who initiated the consolidation (FK to the NC user directory — a person is an NC entity, never an invented schema).

executionTimestamp.description: When the consolidation run was initiated (REQ-CONS-008).

totalEliminationCount.description: Computed count of elimination entries in this period (aggregation).

totalEliminationAmount.description: Computed total elimination amount (debit side) in reporting currency (aggregation).

mismatches.description: Exception queue for out-of-tolerance intercompany differences (design D3).

intercompanyRelationId.description: FK to the IntercompanyRelation that mismatched.

resolvedBy.description: Nextcloud user id that resolved the mismatch.

totalEliminationAmount.description: totalEliminationAmount = SUM(EliminationEntry.lines[].debit) for approved eliminations of this period (REQ-CONS-002).

open.label: Open
open.description: Group setup complete; source administrations closed; pre-elimination aggregation runs.

eliminationPhase.label: Elimination phase
eliminationPhase.description: Pre-elimination werkpapier generated; intercompany matching runs; mismatches queued; elimination entries generated.

review.label: Review
review.description: Accountant reviews each elimination entry (approve/reject); balances must reconcile (REQ-CONS-008).

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: Snapshot immutably archived; no further changes (REQ-CONS-008).

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Moved to long-term retention (7+ years, art. 2:404-405 BW).

startElimination.label: Start elimination phase
startElimination.description: Begin matching once every active entity's source GL is confirmed complete (REQ-CONS-002).

submitForReview.label: Submit for review
submitForReview.description: Submit once at least one elimination exists and no mismatch is left pending (REQ-CONS-008).

close.label: Close consolidation
close.description: Close once every elimination entry is approved (none pending/rejected) and the accountant signs off (REQ-CONS-008).

archive.label: Archive consolidation
archive.description: Move the closed snapshot to long-term retention.

reopenToElimination.label: Return to elimination
reopenToElimination.description: Return to elimination phase to correct rejected entries.

EliminationEntry.title: Elimination Entry
EliminationEntry.description: An individual elimination booking within a consolidation period (REQ-CONS-003 / REQ-CONS-004). Carries debit/credit lines per GL account, the source entities/transactions for drill-down, the auto-generated flag and the full accountant-review audit trail (who/when/why, design D7). Immutable once the period closes; a reversal is a new entry, never an overwrite (REQ-CONS-008).

eliminationType.description: Type of elimination booking (REQ-CONS-003 / REQ-CONS-004 / REQ-CONS-005 / REQ-CONS-006 / REQ-CONS-007).

lines.description: Debit/credit entries per GL account; debit total must equal credit total (REQ-CONS-003).

sourceEntities.description: GroupEntity ids involved in the elimination (REQ-CONS-008).

sourceTransactions.description: Links to the original journalEntry ids in the source administrations for drill-down (REQ-CONS-008).

autoGenerated.description: True when system-generated by the matching engine; false when manually entered (design D7).

reviewedBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the accountant who reviewed (FK to NC user directory).

pending.label: Awaiting review
pending.description: Generated or entered; awaiting accountant review.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Accountant approved; flows into the consolidated output and group GL.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: Accountant rejected with rationale; backed out of the consolidation (REQ-CONS-008).

approve.label: Approve elimination
approve.description: Approve once a reviewer is recorded (REQ-CONS-008).

reject.label: Reject elimination
reject.description: Reject once a reviewer and rationale are recorded (REQ-CONS-008).

TranslationAdjustment.title: Translation Adjustment
TranslationAdjustment.description: Currency revaluation (CTA) for a foreign-currency entity per the current-rate method (RJ 122 / IAS 21, REQ-CONS-005). Records the functional- and reporting-currency amounts and the isolated CTA component posted to OCI/eigen vermogen — never to the P&L (design D4).

translationMethod.description: Rate applied: current (balansposten), average (V&W), historical (eigen vermogen) per RJ 122 / IAS 21 (design D4).

amountInFunctionalCurrency.description: Amount in the entity's functional currency (REQ-CONS-005).

amountInReportingCurrency.description: Translated amount in the group reporting currency (REQ-CONS-005).

ctaComponent.description: CTA portion posted to OCI/eigen vermogen; non-recycling until desinvestering (REQ-CONS-005).

MinorityInterest.title: Minority Interest
MinorityInterest.description: Non-controlling interest tracking per entity with ownership <100% (REQ-CONS-006). Records the third-party percentage and rolls the opening balance + period result share − dividend forward to the closing balance, presented separately under geconsolideerd eigen vermogen as "Aandeel derden" (RJ 217 §8 / IFRS 10 §B95-B96, design D6).

entityId.description: FK to the GroupEntity with ownership <100% (REQ-CONS-006).

thirdPartyPercentage.description: Percentage held by third parties = 100 − ownershipPercentage (REQ-CONS-006).

periodResultShare.description: Computed minority share of current-period profit (negative = loss) (aggregation).

closingBalance.description: closingBalance = openingBalance + periodResultShare − dividendToMinority (REQ-CONS-006, design D6). Declarative per ADR-031 — no MinorityInterestCalculator.php.

Goodwill.title: Goodwill
Goodwill.description: Acquisition goodwill/badwill with amortisation schedule (REQ-CONS-007). On first consolidation of an acquired subsidiary, purchasePrice − fairValueNetAssetsAcquired = goodwill (positive) or badwill (negative). Amortisation method is gated by the group's reportingFramework: RJ linear (10/20yr) vs IFRS impairment-test (design D5).

fairValueNetAssetsAcquired.description: Fair value of identifiable net assets acquired (RJ 216 / IFRS 3, REQ-CONS-007).

goodwillAmount.description: Computed: purchasePrice − fairValueNetAssetsAcquired (positive = goodwill, negative = badwill) (calculation).

amortizationMethod.description: Treatment gated by ConsolidationGroup.reportingFramework: RJ linear amortisation or IFRS annual impairment (design D5).

residualValue.description: Residual value at end of amortisation.

impairmentCorrections.description: IFRS impairment-test results (IAS 36) when reportingFramework = IFRS10.

goodwillAmount.description: goodwillAmount = purchasePrice − fairValueNetAssetsAcquired (positive = goodwill, negative = badwill) per RJ 216 / IFRS 3 (REQ-CONS-007, design D5). Declarative per ADR-031 — no GoodwillCalculator.php.

ConsolidatedBalance.title: Consolidated Balance
ConsolidatedBalance.description: Output object with aggregated + eliminated balance totals per RGS-rapportageregel, with comparative prior-year columns (REQ-CONS-002 / REQ-CONS-009). The balance-sheet equation totalAssets = totalLiabilities + totalEquity must hold (design D10, validated by ConsolidationGuard).

lines.description: One row per RGS-rapportageregel with pre/post-elimination and comparative figures (design D10).

eliminationAdjustments.description: EliminationEntry line ids applied to this row.

totalEquity.description: Computed total equity incl. minority interest + CTA (aggregation).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Generated; pre/post-elimination figures may still change.

published.label: Published
published.description: Deposited with KvK / issued for management reporting.

ConsolidatedIncomeStatement.title: Consolidated Income Statement
ConsolidatedIncomeStatement.description: Output object with consolidated V&W per RGS-rapportageregel, split between parent shareholders and minority interest, with comparative prior-year columns (REQ-CONS-002 / REQ-CONS-006 / REQ-CONS-009). The split netProfitTotal = attributedToParent + attributedToMinority must hold (validated by ConsolidationGuard).

lines.description: One row per RGS-rapportageregel with pre/post-elimination and split figures (design D10).

netProfitAttributedToParent.description: Computed net profit attributable to parent shareholders (REQ-CONS-006).

netProfitAttributedToMinority.description: Computed net profit attributable to minority interest (REQ-CONS-006).

finalize.label: Finalise income statement
finalize.description: Finalise once netProfit = parent + minority split (REQ-CONS-006).

objects.notes: Voorbeeld-consolidatiegroep: Holding BV (moeder) + Werk BV (100%-dochter). Operators pas dit aan per eigen entiteit.
Werk BV verkoopt aan Holding BV; 8200 Intercompany sales ↔ 7200 Intercompany purchases.
